03 · 20 resources

Speech-to-text (STT / ASR)

Pick one streaming STT and learn it deeply before shopping around. Deepgram, AssemblyAI, and Whisper-derivatives cover most use cases. (All-in-one ASR + end-of-turn models like Deepgram Flux are covered under turn-taking.)

Suggested learning path: Week 3: Components

PickTypeBest for
Deepgram Nova-3CommercialGeneral-purpose, 36+ languages
AssemblyAI Universal-3 ProCommercialAccuracy, diarization
SonioxCommercialMultilingual + built-in translation
faster-whisperOpen sourceSelf-hosted Whisper
NVIDIA Parakeet (NeMo)Open sourceTop-of-leaderboard accuracy

20 resources

  • Deepgram Nova-3: STT benchmarksdeepgram.com

    Primer on WER, latency, and cost alongside Deepgram's product reference; Nova-3 spans 36+ languages with multilingual code-switching.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • AssemblyAI Universal-3 Pro Streamingassemblyai.com

    Streaming STT walkthrough that doubles as a function-calling tutorial; Universal-3 Pro Streaming is the current real-time flagship, adding real-time diarization and keyterm prompting.

    IntermediateCommercial APIs
  • OpenAI Whisper / gpt-4o-transcribe API docsdevelopers.openai.com

    Easiest cloud STT if you already use OpenAI.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Cartesia Ink 2docs.cartesia.ai

    GA streaming STT with built-in eager turn detection and noise robustness, paired with Sonic TTS for a single-vendor low-latency stack.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Soniox Speech-to-Textsoniox.com

    One model spanning 60+ languages with real-time WebSocket streaming and async APIs, speaker diarization, language identification, endpoint detection, and built-in real-time speech translation (one-way or two-way).

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • Speechmatics Meliaspeechmatics.com

    Single-pass multilingual STT with native code-switching across 56+ languages.

    IntermediateCommercial APIs
  • Gladia Solaria-3gladia.io

    STT tuned for noisy, multi-speaker European business audio (9.6% WER on English production calls).

    IntermediateCommercial APIs
  • Gradium STTdocs.gradium.ai

    Streaming STT with built-in semantic VAD; step messages every 80 ms carry end-of-turn probabilities so agents can decide when a speaker has finished.

    BeginnerCommercial APIs
  • openai/whispergithub.com

    The original repo and the de facto starting point for any DIY ASR project.

    BeginnerOpen source
  • SYSTRAN/faster-whispergithub.com

    CTranslate2 reimplementation up to 4× faster with INT8; recommended for self-hosted Whisper.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • NVIDIA NeMo (Parakeet / Canary)github.com

    Top-of-leaderboard open ASR models with streaming inference recipes.

    AdvancedOpen source
  • FunASRgithub.com

    Industrial open-source ASR toolkit with Paraformer, SenseVoice, VAD, punctuation, diarization, streaming services, and an OpenAI-compatible API for self-hosted voice agents.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • SenseVoicegithub.com

    Multilingual speech understanding model for ASR, language identification, emotion recognition, and audio event detection, with FunASR integration and ONNX/libtorch export examples.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • Moonshinegithub.com

    Tiny on-device ASR (tiny 27M / base 61M params); v2 adds an ergodic streaming encoder built for latency-critical live transcription on edge devices.

    IntermediateOpen source
  • NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6Bhuggingface.co

    Open-weights cache-aware FastConformer streaming ASR across 40 locales, with runtime-configurable latency (80 ms to 1.1 s).

    AdvancedOpen source
  • Open ASR Leaderboard (HuggingFace)huggingface.co

    Community leaderboard across 11 datasets: your reference for open-source picks.

    BeginnerBenchmarks and explainers
  • Artificial Analysis: Speech-to-Textartificialanalysis.ai

    Independent leaderboard ranking 48+ STT providers by WER, speed, and cost.

    BeginnerBenchmarks and explainers
  • Best Speech-to-Text Providers in 2026 (Coval)coval.ai

    Independent benchmark across 14 providers (WER, latency, end-of-turn, cost), with guidance on testing against your own traffic.

    IntermediateBenchmarks and explainers
  • Best Speech-to-Text APIs in 2026 (Deepgram)deepgram.com

    Provider comparison guide; note the commercial author.

    BeginnerCommercial authorBenchmarks and explainers

    Engineer-friendly explainer of RNN-T and Conformer streaming architectures.
